title: Nazi criminal Josef Mengele suffers a stroke and drowns while swimming in Bertioga. His remains are found six years later.
text: Josef Mengele, often dubbed the "Angel of Death" (German: Todesengel), was a German military officer and physician during World War II at the Soviet front and then at Auschwitz during the Holocaust. He conducted research and experiments on prisoners at the Auschwitz II-Birkenau concentration camp, where he was a member of the team of doctors who selected victims to be murdered in the gas chambers.

title: João Figueiredo is sworn in as the 30th President of Brazil.
text: João Baptista de Oliveira Figueiredo was a Brazilian military officer who served as the 30th president of Brazil from 1979 to 1985, and the last of the military regime that ruled the country following the 1964 Brazilian coup d'état. He was chief of the Secret Service (SNI) during the term of his predecessor, Ernesto Geisel, who appointed him to the presidency at the end of his own term.

title: Eunice Michiles becomes the first woman to hold a seat in the Federal Senate.
text: Eunice Mafalda Michiles is a Brazilian writer, teacher and politician. In 1979, she took office as Senator for Amazonas, being the first woman to take office in the Federal Senate after Princess Isabel of Brazil.

title: The National Association of Newspapers is founded, with the aim of defending freedom of the press.
text: Freedom of the press also known as Free Press or freedom of the media is the fundamental principle that communication and expression through various media, including printed and electronic media, especially published materials, should be considered a right to be exercised freely. title: Dr. Roberto Farina is acquitted of all criminal liability in connection with the first male-to-female gender-affirming surgery performed in Brazil.
text: The Roberto Farina Case was a legal proceeding that attracted international attention to Brazil during the late 1970s. The case stemmed from the first male-to-female gender-affirming surgery performed in Brazil in the city of São Paulo.
